---
title: "How Accurate are Heading Values?"
author: "Peter Claussen"
date: "2023-01-12"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
seeding2018.dat <- read.csv('../data/A 2018 Corn Seeding.csv')
```

```{r}
rows <- dim(seeding2018.dat)[1]
seeding2018.dat$Heading = seeding2018.dat$Heading*pi/180
seeding2018.dat$HeadingEst <- NA
for(i in 2:rows) {
  current <- seeding2018.dat[i,]
  prev <- seeding2018.dat[i-1,]
  DeltaEasting = current$Easting - prev$Easting
  DeltaNorthing = current$Northing - prev$Northing
  seeding2018.dat$HeadingEst[i] <- abs(atan(DeltaEasting/DeltaNorthing))
}
plot(HeadingEst ~ Heading,data=seeding2018.dat)
```
